parts.what: BSB Translation Tables (words, translit, parsing, Strong's, English rendering)

parts.licence: Public domain (file prologue: "Public Domain -- Copy Freely")

name: Hebrew-Greek interlinear (BSB Translation Tables + Strong's): sample (3John, Obad)
notes: Glosses are the BSB's English rendering of each word, not a neutral word-for-word gloss. Words with no Strong's number in the source (chiefly Hebrew prepositions with pronominal suffixes) are left without one. Berean asks that works differing from its official text not use the Berean name; this pack is named for its data source only.

sample.note: A cut of the full pack, committed to git so a fresh clone has interlinear data. Book files are byte-identical to the full pack's; strongs.json and morph_codes.json keep only the entries these books use. The full pack ships as a release artifact (docs/UPDATES.md).

shape.lexiconFile: strongs.json ({lemma, translit, short}; Strong's own definitions only)
shape.strongsFormat: H|G + 4-digit zero-padded base number, no letter suffix
shape.wordOrder: source reading order (Hebrew/Aramaic right to left when displayed)

source.modifications: Tab-separated word rows regrouped by verse (BSB English versification, keyed by OSIS id) and ordered in source reading order using the Heb Sort / Greek Sort columns; rows with no source-language word dropped; Strong's numbers prefixed H/G and zero-padded to four digits (Aramaic numbers use H); lemma set to the Strong's headword for the word's number; English rendering ('gloss') kept verbatim, including the '-' (no English counterpart), '. . .' and [bracketed supplied words] conventions; Berean parsing code kept verbatim as 'morph' with its own spelled-out expansion collected into morph_codes.json; Greek words carrying an edition mark in the source keep the marked form in 'marked'; Aramaic words tagged lang 'arc'; no Unicode normalisation applied. Sample: restricted to 3John, Obad; lexicon and morph-code files cut to the entries those books use.

sourceTexts.NT: Nestle 1904 base with edition marks (as used by the BSB)
sourceTexts.OT: Westminster Leningrad Codex (as used by the BSB)
